title: Element Frequency Count
statement:
Given an array of N integers, print the frequency of each distinct element in the order of their first occurrence.

Output each line as: `element frequency`
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: For each distinct element (in order of first occurrence), print `element frequency` on its own line.

examples.explanation: 4 appears 3 times (first), 2 appears 2 times, 3 appears 1 time.
